plugins.name: plantime
plugins.description: Run your Plantime workforce schedule from Claude: read team rosters, plan and copy shifts, auto-assign staff, and review or approve timesheets over the authenticated Plantime MCP connector.

skills.name: auto-assign
skills.description: Run the Plantime auto-assign planner over a team's open shifts and review what it filled
skills.description_zh: 运行 Plantime 自动分配规划器，为团队空缺班次分配人员并检查填补结果。

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Build out a Plantime team's schedule for a period — copy a week, repeat a template, or fill from history
skills.description_zh: 构建指定期间的 Plantime 团队排班，通过复制一周、重复模板或依据历史填充完成计划。

skills.name: planning
skills.description: Plan and staff shifts in a Plantime workspace — read team schedules, create/copy/repeat/delete shifts, assign people, run the auto-assign planner, and report coverage and hours. Triggers on "plan next week", "add a shift", "copy this week's rota", "who's working Tuesday", "auto-assign the open shifts", "where are the gaps", "how many hours did we plan", "take Maria off next week".
skills.description_zh: 在 Plantime 工作区读取排班、创建复制重复或删除班次、安排人员并运行自动分配，报告覆盖和小时数。适用于周计划、人员安排、缺口及计划工时检查。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Check the Plantime connector is authenticated and working, and explain how to fix it if not
skills.description_zh: 检查 Plantime 连接器认证和运行情况，并说明故障时的修复方法。

skills.name: timesheets
skills.description: Triage, read, approve, reject and recalculate Plantime timesheets — the two-sided worker/manager approval model, the pending/approved/rejected/disputed statuses, and how to read the minutes and pay-cents fields. Triggers on "show pending timesheets", "approve my timesheet", "sign off the hours", "why is this timesheet disputed", "recalculate the hours for last month".
skills.description_zh: 处理 Plantime 工时表的读取、分诊、批准、拒绝及重算，解释员工与经理双向审批、待处理/批准/拒绝/争议状态，以及分钟和薪酬分字段。

skills.name: workspace
skills.description: Show your Plantime organizations, teams, roles and planning windows
skills.description_zh: 展示 Plantime 组织、团队、角色及可规划时间窗口。
